description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

SanMar is seeking an Associate Software Developer to translate business requirements into software designs and develop Java-based applications. The role involves building front-end interfaces, testing and troubleshooting software, documenting procedures, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and supporting software development practices and emerging technologies.
Java application developer building web interfaces, testing software, and troubleshooting technical issues

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable Java-based applications
• Complete documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
• Develop and implement user-friendly front-end interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Write clean, efficient, and well-structured code that adheres to best practices
• Conduct thorough unit testing to ensure code quality and reliability
• Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner
• Perform other duties as assigned
• Comply with all policies and standards

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field or equivalent experience
• Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts and Java development
• Experience with front-end development using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, DevOps organizations, and the stages of the Software Development Lifecycle
• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Services and Azure DevOps
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline development
• Familiarity with Stored Procedures and SQL
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Preferred:
• Experience with JUnit testing or other testing frameworks is preferred
• Experience working with SAP Commerce / Hybris is preferred
